tasks.subject: Task 0: Reference folder for the exam objectives
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add a git-ignored `reference/` folder with a tracked README, and put the objectives PDF there locally.

**Files:**
- Modify: `.gitignore`
- Create: `reference/README.md`
- Local only: `reference/CompTIA-A-220-1201-V15-Exam-Objectives-4.0.pdf`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `git check-ignore reference/CompTIA-A-220-1201-V15-Exam-Objectives-4.0.pdf` prints the path
- [ ] `git check-ignore reference/README.md` prints nothing and exits 1
- [ ] `pdftotext -l 2 reference/*.pdf -` contains `Exam Objectives Document Version 4.0`

**Verify:** `git status --short reference/` → shows only `?? reference/README.md` before the commit

```json:metadata
{"files": [".gitignore", "reference/README.md", "reference/CompTIA-A-220-1201-V15-Exam-Objectives-4.0.pdf"], "verifyCommand": "`git status --short reference/` \u2192 shows only `?? reference/README.md` before the commit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`git check-ignore reference/CompTIA-A-220-1201-V15-Exam-Objectives-4.0.pdf` prints the path", "`git check-ignore reference/README.md` prints nothing and exits 1", "`pdftotext -l 2 reference/*.pdf -` contains `Exam Objectives Document Version 4.0`"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 1: Playtest simulation tool
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `tools/playtest.js` runs a fixed range of bot games, then prints playability statistics. A learner-error option models a student who places parts that don't fit.

**Files:**
- Create: `tools/playtest.js`
- Create: `test/playtest.test.js`
- Modify: `eslint.config.mjs`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `node tools/playtest.js --games 20` exits 0 and prints the sections `Phase 1`, `POST race`, `Spec Sheets`, `Per player per game` and `Cards stuck in hand`
- [ ] The same options give the same output every run
- [ ] With 60 games, failed POST calls per game for `--learner-error 0.8` are higher than for `--learner-error 0`
- [ ] Unknown options exit with an error message
- [ ] `npm run lint` and `npm test` pass

**Verify:** `npm test 2>&1 | grep -E '^# (pass|fail)'` → `# fail 0`

```json:metadata
{"files": ["tools/playtest.js", "tools/playtest.js", "test/playtest.test.js", "eslint.config.mjs"], "verifyCommand": "`npm test 2>&1 | grep -E '^# (pass|fail)'` \u2192 `# fail 0`", "acceptanceCriteria": ["`node tools/playtest.js --games 20` exits 0 and prints the sections `Phase 1`, `POST race`, `Spec Sheets`, `Per player per game` and `Cards stuck in hand`", "The same options give the same output every run", "With 60 games, failed POST calls per game for `--learner-error 0.8` are higher than for `--learner-error 0`", "Unknown options exit with an error message", "`npm run lint` and `npm test` pass"]}
```
